upstream.identity_proof: The build fetches exactly one commit and asserts both the commit id and the tree id before any upstream byte is used. A git object id is a content address, so equality of the asserted ids is equality of the source tree.

access_class.notes: Only the AlphaFold 3 source code is redistributable and only the source code is present in this image. Model parameters are covered by the AlphaFold 3 Weights Terms of Use, are obtained by the operator directly from Google, and are never embedded, layered, cached or exported by this runtime.

cuda.reason: Matches the upstream AlphaFold 3 Dockerfile base exactly. nvcr.io is not reachable from the build environment (HTTP 403), and the official public Docker Hub nvidia/cuda image is the same content NVIDIA publishes.

uv.reason: Upstream pins uv 0.9.24; the digest pins the exact binary.

external_build_artifacts.name: hmmer
external_build_artifacts.transport_note: eddylab.org serves plain HTTP only. Integrity is enforced by the pinned SHA-256 checksum, which is what upstream AlphaFold 3 also relies on.
external_build_artifacts.patched_with: docker/jackhmmer_seq_limit.patch from the pinned upstream commit

python_environment.lock: upstream uv.lock at the pinned commit
python_environment.deviation_from_upstream: Upstream builds with --all-groups, which installs the pytest dev group. This runtime omits dev dependencies because the image is a production batch runtime and its smoke and semantic checks are implemented by af3_runtime.py, not by pytest. Nothing in the resolved runtime dependency set differs.
python_environment.version_provenance: setuptools-scm git metadata is intentionally absent in the image, so SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION is set to 3.0.4 and the built distribution version is asserted to equal 3.0.4. A silent fall back to the pyproject placeholder version fails the build.

nondeterministic_inputs: Ubuntu 24.04 apt package versions for python3.12, zlib1g, libgomp1, zstd, ca-certificates and the build-only compilers
reproducibility.mitigation: Exact installed apt package versions are captured into the build receipt at build time, so apt drift is detectable by comparing receipts rather than being invisible.

cache_levels.L1: image-local: AlphaFold 3 source, python environment, HMMER binaries and the Chemical Component Dictionary derived data are inside the image layers.
cache_levels.auxiliary_compiler_cache: The persistent JAX/Triton/XDG directories under /cache/alphafold3 are an XLA and Triton compilation cache. They are not a GPU memory snapshot and must not be reported as one.
cache_levels.unclaimed: No L2 or higher cache level is claimed. Any such claim requires measured evidence recorded by the fast-start qualification task.
